performance.verdict: Ads never launched; 5 overdue milestones are the real emergency.

findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, and Site/Landing Pages — all due 2026-07-31 — show no completed event, blocking every paid channel.
Ads Launch (LSA + Search) and Meta Retargeting — due 2026-08-01 — remain unlaunched; $0 spend across all 28 days confirms zero go-live.
CPL is undefined: $0 spent and 0 paid leads over 28 days. No efficiency metric exists because no paid activity has ever run.
GBP actions dropped to 0 for the last 3 days (Sep 1–3) vs. an avg of ~3 in the prior 3 days (Aug 29–31), extending the -31.82% 7d trend into a confirmed 3-day signal.
GHL shows 110 contacts and 21 opportunities created but 0 appointments and 0 won — intake pipeline exists but no consults are booking, suggesting a routing or speed-to-lead gap.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; no paid spend can run until stack test and LSA verification are cleared.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones are overdue by 33+ days: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages (all due Jul 31), and both Ads Launch items (due Aug 1). Zero spend and zero paid leads over 28 days confirm nothing has gone live. Nacer must provide a confirmed completion date for each item by 2026-09-08. Success check: stack test passed event logged and LSA submission confirmed in the Google Ads account by that date.

suggestions.text: Investigate GHL appointment booking flow — 21 opportunities created but 0 appointments booked points to a broken calendar or routing link.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 21 opportunities created with 0 appointments booked and 0 won cases — a complete drop-off between pipeline entry and consult scheduling. Test the calendar booking link end-to-end and confirm auto-assignment routing is live per the SOW. Success check: at least 1 test appointment successfully created and appearing in the pipeline by 2026-09-08.
